rationale: B wins because it asks cleaner, more reportable questions and keeps its proof demands sharper. Its counterposition angle, "Bumble's AI writes the opening message on the app built around who sends it," is tighter than A's "If AI Writes the First Message, Is Bumble's Women-First Model Still Feminist?", which drags in a feminism frame the supplied facts do not actually give. A also steps on a rake with "Bumble is the highest-profile dating platform to deploy AI matchmaking and AI-assisted message writing at scale"; that is an invented weight-bearing claim, not seasoning.
gaps_in_A: "Bumble is the highest-profile dating platform to deploy AI matchmaking and AI-assisted message writing at scale" is not in the update. Highest-profile and at-scale are exactly the sort of shiny little overclaims that get a pitch killed in paragraph two.

"If AI Writes the First Message, Is Bumble's Women-First Model Still Feminist?" imports a feminism frame the facts do not supply. The real angle is product premise versus AI authorship; do not dress it up in politics unless you can source it.
"the AI relaunch is the first major move under her return" is asserted as a fact, but the update only says the relaunch is under the returning founder-CEO. First major move needs confirmation.
The fourth angle leans on a trend it has not earned: "Dating Apps Embrace AI Matchmaking" needs other dating apps, and A admits that proof is missing. Good instinct, underbuilt floor.
gaps_in_B: "the first substantive product move since the founder's return this year" is not supplied. B is cleaner than A, but this still needs a source before it becomes pitch copy.

"Dating apps are selling AI to users who say AI ruins dating" overstates the fact pattern. The update says some users criticized AI in dating as inauthentic; "ruins dating" is hotter than the evidence.
"the company has made a claim the next disclosure will settle" is too strong. A relaunch after a decline implies a test, but it is not the same as a stated company claim.

The trend angle still needs outside evidence before it can stand: "comparable AI moves by other dating apps" is correctly named as proof, but without it this is a Bumble story wearing a category-story jacket.
